Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
Card Q&A.q: This card has multiple effects that trigger when it digivolves or when it attacks. In what order can they be activated?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for the 1st [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect require you to trash the specified number of digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can I trash just 1 digivolution card for the conditions of this card's 1st [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
Can I use this card's 1st [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to trash a total of 3 digivolution cards from my multiple different Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for the 2nd [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect require you to place the specified number of cards in digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can I place just 1 card in digivolution cards for the conditions of this card's 2nd [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By trashing 3 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait cards from any of your Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon and trash their top security card.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 3 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait cards from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards, it unsuspends.
